exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.cue: Keep shoulder blades pinned and feet planted.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Body in one straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.cue: Hinge to about 45 degrees and pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbows; do not lean back far.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.cue: Start from a dead hang; chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Pull to eye level and rotate the hands out.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes; press in a straight line.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.cue: Knees track over toes; hips below parallel.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar close to the shins; push the floor away.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees; push the hips back until hamstrings stretch.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Lower back stays on the pad.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: Long step; back knee nearly touches the floor.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Lock the elbows in; finish with straight arms.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight; hold the position.
